_note: Pre-registered 2026-11-02 evening, BEFORE any result for this strategy existed (only SPY was ever backtested, with the SMA rule). Do not edit to fit a result. To change a criterion, add a dated entry to docs/research/log.md saying why, then edit.
idea: Cross-sectional 12-1 momentum rotation over ETFs, monthly. Source: Jegadeesh-Titman 1993; mmr STRATEGY_EVALUATION (its one durable result). See docs/research/log.md.
universe_note: Fixed now, by asset-class coverage, not by performance. Known bias: every one of these still exists, so survivorship flatters the result somewhat. Sample starts when all ten have data.

rule.score: close[t-21] / close[t-252] - 1 on the last trading day of each month (skips the latest month)
rule.hold: top 3 by score, only those with score > 0; empty slots stay in cash
rule.weights: equal, 1/3 of equity per slot, rebalanced monthly

benchmarks: equal weight of all ten, rebalanced monthly, same engine and costs

variants_tried.note: Only the primary can pass. The other four are a fragility check and are all reported.

negative_control: 200 versions with the SAME random permutation of days applied to all ten assets: keeps each asset's returns and the correlations between assets, destroys serial structure (what momentum needs).
pass_all_of: primary net Sharpe > SPY buy-and-hold Sharpe AND > equal-weight-all Sharpe (selection must add value beyond diversification)
primary max drawdown shallower than SPY buy and hold
primary net Sharpe > 0 in both halves of the sample (split at the middle date)
primary beats at least 95% of the shuffled controls on Sharpe (necessary, not sufficient)
at least 4 of the 5 variants have net Sharpe > equal-weight-all Sharpe
if_fail: Report it as a failure. No retuning, no extra variants. Continue research on other strategies.
if_pass: Still not proof of an edge: next step is paper trading per evidence/gate.json (100 round trips, 60 days, net positive). Not real money.

universe_amendment.reason: IBKR returns TLT history only from 2016-02 and IEF only from 2017-08 (they moved listing to NASDAQ; older history is not served), which would cut the common sample to 9 years, below the pre-registered 10-year minimum. AGG and TIP (NYSE Arca) have the full history from 2006-11.
universe_amendment.cost: The long-duration Treasury sleeve (TLT) is gone, so the bond side is broad and inflation-linked, not long Treasuries. Noted as a limitation.
